transcription: Music Sticky floors and dim lights, another Friday night My old guitar case open wide For tips that barely hide the cost of strings and gas to roam This town I call my home But every chord I strike feels right Baiting this smoky light They say this ain't a life, it's just a phase Lost in a million hazy days But when I see those few who sing along I know this is where I belong Cause I'm playing for the ones who understand This one out six string in my hand From the sty ball stage I cast my plea Dreaming of a stadium wild and free Tonight, it's just you and me Yeah, tonight, it's just you and me Oh, the crowd is small, but the spirit's bold A story waiting to unfold So I'll poster on the wall today A band I used to play with Back when we were kids so keen Now they're on the silver screen It stings a little I won't lie, as another lonely hour drips by But the rhythm of the kick drum keeps me whole feeding This hungry soul, they say this ain't a life, it's just a phase Lost in a million hazy days But when I see those few who sing along I know this is where I belong Cause I'm playing for the ones who understand This one out six string in my hand From the sty ball stage I cast my plea Dreaming of a stadium wild and free Tonight, it's just you and me Yeah, tonight, it's just you and me Maybe tomorrow the stars will align Maybe the stream will follow behind But there's a magic in this humble sound On this hologramic ground 💖 Cause I'm playing for the ones who understand This one out six string in my hand From the sty ball stage I cast my plea Dreaming of a stadium wild and free But tonight, it's just you and me Yeah, tonight, it's just you and me 💖
